heading: Today
text: Patchy fog thinning for some sun.  Building clouds leading to a few scattered showers or thunderstorms midday, then numerous showers and storms spreading from NY and the St. Lawrence east late afternoon and evening, some with gusty winds, hail, and heavy rain.  Warmer.  Highs in the upper 70s to low 80s.  South winds near 10 mph, gusting to 20 mph east of the Green Mountains, and 10 to 15 mph, gusting to 30 mph from the Green Mountains west.

heading: Tonight
text: Showers likely, a few locally strong thunderstorms, with strong winds, hail, and heavy rain, diminishing through the overnight.  Mild and more humid.  Lows in the upper 50s to low 60s.  Winds south near 10 mph, gusting to 25 mph, becoming southwest and diminishing late.

heading: Friday
text: Intervals of clouds and sun, with a few passing, local showers or a thunderstorm.  Highs in the 70s to low 80s.  Southwest winds near 10 mph, becoming north in the afternoon.
